headline: Gold eases slightly today; silver sits near the low end of the past 18 days
summary: Today's change is tiny: 24k gold is down ₹1 to ₹14,197 per gram (about -0.01%), and 22k is down ₹1 to ₹13,014. Compared with 7 days ago, 24k gold has fallen ₹405 (-2.77%) and silver is down ₹10,100 per kg (-4.81%) to ₹1,99,900. Over the 18 days covered, silver has dropped 9.14% from ₹2,20,000 on 26 October, and today's rate is its lowest in that period; the likely drivers are movements in international prices, the US dollar and the rupee, though spot prices were unchanged from today's rate in this data.
outlook: Prices are down over the past week, so there is no urgency; if you are buying jewellery, compare the making charges and GST rather than the base rate alone.
